snippet.title: MUSHROOM KINGDOM SHOWDOWN! [v.1.0 Full Version]
snippet.description:
Game DOWNLOAD: http://www.mediafire.com/download/3lmc6pa2ip34ig3/Mushroom+Kingdom+SHOWDOWN.zip

Mfa Working File DOWNLOAD: http://www.mediafire.com/download/lljw8s8x6iv952v/Mario+Smash+Bros..mfa

Some of you might get an error while opening the file, saying you need extensions. They are easy to download and install. Look up a quick tutorial on how to do it. Extensions are basically new objects for the game that I've used in MKS that your version of MMF2 doesn't have. As I said, these are easy to get. Here are some links you can get extensions from: 

http://www.andersriggelsen.dk/mmf2_extensions.php

http://dark-wire.com/store/extlist.php

https://sites.google.com/site/mmf2stuff/Data


The final update for MKS :) I hope you like that I'm giving you the gamefiles :D I was against it at first, but after thinking more, I thought it could be very fun to let you guys have the freedom to do whatever you want with the game! Thanks for all of you who have followed this game, and check out the MKS Wiki here:

mushroom-kingdom-showdown.wikia.com/wiki/Mushroom_Kingdom_Showdown_Wiki
